message.content: {"0": {"original": "A Swedish court sentenced four TPB administrators to prison and damages for版权侵权。", "rephrased": "A Swedish court has sentenced four administrators of the file-sharing site The Pirate Bay to serve prison terms and pay damages for copyright infringement, a legal outcome that establishes official liability for the operators.", "summary": "A Swedish court sentenced four The Pirate Bay administrators to prison and damages for copyright infringement."}, "1": {"original": "The court has found four individuals guilty of accessory to breaching copyright", "rephrased": "The Stockholm district court has found four individuals guilty of accessory to breaching copyright laws and sentenced each to one year in prison, confirming the legal system's enforcement of intellectual property rights against the site's operators.", "summary": "The Stockholm district court sentenced four individuals to one year in prison for breaching copyright laws."}, "2": {"original": "A Swedish court sentenced four administrators to prison, but TPB operators", "rephrased": "Although a Swedish court sentenced four administrators to prison, the operators of The Pirate Bay dismiss the verdict as a media stunt and refuse to pay the imposed fines, asserting that file-sharing operations will continue unaffected.", "summary": "The Pirate Bay operators dismissed the prison verdict as a media stunt and refused to pay fines."}}
